sentences.text: During the inquiry, it has been gathered that Directors of the said company had organized a seminar behind hotel Shanti Palace, Ujjain wherein it was assured by the present applicant along with the other co-accused persons that money invested by the investors will be doubled in 5 years and 6 months.
About 1258 investors have invested the amount of around Rs.9,37,01,437/-.
When the policies got matured for payment, the payment was not made by the company and the company directors have played fraud with the investors.
Accordingly offence has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He is in custody since 1.12.2022.

Applicant has worked with the company at Indore on the post of Branch Manager from 12.9.2013 to 31.8.2016 and he has no connection whatsoever with the money collected by the office of the company situated at District Dhar.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
Co-accused Manjula Gaur and Mehmud Hussain have been enlarged on bail vide order dated 3.3.2022 and 8.7.2022 passed in MCRC No.5510/2022 and MCRC No.27809/2022.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Jhabua.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
Per-contra, learned PL for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
SAVNER

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that present applicant is named in the FIR as Accused No.13 and he has taken active participation in the aforesaid offence being a Branch Manager, although co-accused Manjula Gaur and Mehmud Hussain have been enlarged on bail but they are the employees in the said company, therefore, case of the present applicant is different from the co-accused who have already been enlarged on bail, it is a case of fraud with 1258 investors and huge amount of more than Rs.9 Crores is involved in the said offence,
in view of the above, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. is hereby rejected.
C.C. as per rules

.
